hybrid.reason: Rule A requires production releases to happen overnight, while Rule B requires them to happen at 10 AM, which are mutually exclusive time constraints.
Rule B provides a specific, conditional allowance (an approved override) for renaming customer codes, which is restricted by the general prohibition established in Rule A.
Rule A concerns form management (React Hook Form), and Rule B concerns state management (Redux). These are separate concerns and do not impose mutually exclusive constraints on the project.
Rule A restricts credential rotation to the midnight window, while Rule B mandates the rotation occur at 9 AM. These temporal requirements for the same action are mutually exclusive.

Rule B provides a conditional allowance (migration during recovery windows with specific approvals) that serves as an approved override or exception to the general prohibition established in Rule A (never run migration during business hours).

Rule A concerns UI implementation practices, while Rule B concerns financial administrative approval for a specific task. They operate in separate functional domains and do not impose conflicting constraints on the same action.
Rule A requires completion before sunrise, while Rule B requires the start time to be noon. These temporal constraints are mutually exclusive for the same action.

Rule A sets a strict default mandate (MFA must never be disabled). Rule B provides a specific, controlled, and approved mechanism (human approval, ticket, expiry window) for temporarily overriding that default, making it a governed exception to Rule A.

rules.text: Never rename ERP customer codes after onboarding.
Allow customer code rename for Tenant A only with finance approval and audit logging.
Never run destructive schema migration during business hours.
Allow destructive schema migration during recovery windows only with DBA approval and a documented rollback plan.
Never disable MFA in production.
Allow temporary MFA bypass only with human approval, an incident ticket, and a documented expiry window.
